items.title: Scaffold
items.description: The application starts, reports its health, and has its first test.
items.outcome: `GET /actuator/health` answers `{"status":"UP"}`, only the health endpoint is exposed, virtual threads are on, and `mvn test` runs the project's own tests.
items.scope: the application class; `application.properties`; a first test.

items.title: Products API
items.description: Create, read and list products held in memory.
items.outcome: `POST /api/products` creates a product with a validated name and stock level; `GET /api/products/{id}` and `GET /api/products` return them.
items.scope: request and response records, validation, an in-memory store, controller tests.

items.title: Problem Details errors
items.outcome: validation failures return `400 application/problem+json` with per-field errors, and an unknown product id returns `404 application/problem+json`.
items.scope: error handling for the products API.

items.title: Persistence
items.description: Products are stored in embedded H2 through Spring Data JDBC.
items.outcome: the products API behaves exactly as before, backed by a repository and a schema.

items.title: Reservations
items.outcome: `POST /api/products/{id}/reservations` lowers stock, or answers `409` as a Problem Detail when stock is short, and publishes a `StockReserved` application event.
items.scope: the reservation endpoint, the event, tests.

items.title: Paging and filtering
items.description: List products a page at a time, optionally filtered by name.
items.outcome: `GET /api/products?name=&page=&size=` returns a page with stable ordering.

items.title: Reservations report the stock they left
items.description: A reservation's `remainingStock` (and a refusal's `available`) is the stock right after its own update, even under concurrent reservations.
items.outcome: concurrent reservations each report a distinct, correct `remainingStock`, in the response and the `StockReserved` event; `409` reports the stock as it really is.
items.scope: the reservation logic in `ProductStore`; concurrency tests.

items.title: The name filter matches wildcard characters literally
items.description: `%`, `_` and `\` in the `name` filter match only themselves.
items.outcome: `GET /api/products?name=%` no longer matches every product, and `name=a_b` no longer matches `axb`; the page and its counts include only literal matches.
items.scope: escaping the filter text and the `LIKE` queries; tests.

items.title: Delete a product
items.description: A client removes a product it no longer stocks.
items.outcome: `DELETE /api/products/{id}` answers `204` and the product is gone from every read and reservation; an unknown id answers `404` as a Problem Detail.
items.scope: the endpoint, the store method, tests.

items.title: Update a product's stock
items.description: A client sets a product's stock after a delivery or a count.
items.outcome: `PATCH /api/products/{id}` with `{"stock": n}` sets the stock (`n >= 0`) and answers `200` with the product; invalid bodies answer `400` and unknown ids `404` as Problem Details, changing nothing.
items.scope: the endpoint, its validated body, the store method, tests.
